question: Rs.12000 becomes Rs.15000 in 18 months at a certain rate of interest at simple interest. Find the amount if Rs.5000 invested at the same rate for 30 months at simple interest.(approximately)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a constant rate, SI ∝ P × T ⇒ SI₁ / SI₂ = (P₁ × T₁) / (P₂ × T₂)

⇒ 3000 / SI₂ = (12000 × 18) / (5000 × 30) = 216 / 150

⇒ SI₂ = (3000 × 150) / 216 = 2083.33

⇒ Total Amount = 5000 + 2083.33 ≈ ₹7083

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7083.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Principal (P₁) = ₹12000, Initial Amount (A₁) = ₹15000

Initial Time (T₁) = 18 months = 1.5 years

New Principal (P₂) = ₹5000, New Time (T₂) = 30 months = 2.5 years
